answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40612 Country: India Title: Its an urgent matter.....Plz reply soon Question: I have heard that according to Imam Abu Hanifa and Imam Malik that it is sunnah to offer fardh salah by jamat. Is it correct? Answer ID: 40612 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1225/805/H=1433) It is Sunnah muwakkadah close to wajib. According to Imam Malik (رحمة الله عليه) it is sunnah and this is mentioned in التعليق الصبيح شرح مشكوة المصابيح. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
